quran_text_all_rows.arabic_uthmani: تَعْرُجُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍۢ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍۢ
يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِى مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِيهِ
وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ
وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍۢ
فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَٰدِرُونَ
عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًۭا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍۢ يُوفِضُونَ
خَٰشِعَةً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌۭ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ

parent_channels.name: [P1 70:1-18] Measured Ascent and Collapsing Distance

subchannels.name: Calibrated ascent
subchannels.scene_or_process: An ascent is assigned a day, a quantity, a five-based count, a thousand-fold magnitude, and a span of years.
subchannels.active_motifs: upward ascent `quranic:root_000997:B004/m01`; bounded amount `quranic:root_001205:B001/m01`; the number five `quranic:root_000439:B001/m01`; one thousand `quranic:root_000045:B001/m01`; year-long term `quranic:root_000751:B008/m01`; bounded daylight `quranic:root_001700:B001/m01`; indefinite temporal duration `quranic:root_001700:B002/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `70:3-4` مَعَارِج/تَعْرُج (`ع ر ج`); `70:4` يَوْم، مِقْدَارُهُ، خَمْسِينَ، أَلْفَ، سَنَة (`ي و م`, `ق د ر`, `خ م س`, `ء ل ف`, `س ن و`).
subchannels.synthesis: The ascent is rendered as a calibrated operation: a path rises while day, amount, five, thousand, and year supply nested units. The apparently excessive duration does not defer the endpoint; it identifies the scale on which the ascent is already measured.

subchannels.name: Bent route to a visible height
subchannels.scene_or_process: A route inclines, bends, pauses, and rises until it reaches an exposed high place.
subchannels.active_motifs: bent course `quranic:root_000997:B002/m01`; halt on a route `quranic:root_000997:B003/m01`; upward passage `quranic:root_000997:B004/m01`; elevation `quranic:root_000745:B001/m01`; distant visible height `quranic:root_000745:B002/m01`; overhead canopy `quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`; raised rank `quranic:root_000751:B003/m01`; flood-safe high ground `quranic:root_001476:B004/m01`; elevated cloud or ground `quranic:root_001675:B016/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The lexical path is not a featureless vertical line. It has inclination, stopping points, and visible high ground, so ascent becomes a traversed geography. The high refuge motif also pressures the rescue wish in `70:14`: even terrain above a flood belongs to the same measured route.

subchannels.name: Rival distance judgments
subchannels.scene_or_process: Two observers assign opposite distances to one approaching event.
subchannels.active_motifs: spatial or conceptual remoteness `quranic:root_000131:B001/m01`; induced separation `quranic:root_000131:B003/m01`; spatial or conceptual nearness `quranic:root_001212:B001/m01`; approaching time `quranic:root_001212:B002/m01`; approximate measure `quranic:root_001212:B016/m01`; sensory seeing `quranic:root_000531:B001/m01`; considered judgment `quranic:root_000531:B002/m01`; making visible `quranic:root_000531:B012/m01`; an affair coming due `quranic:root_000001:B006/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `70:6` يَرَوْنَهُ بَعِيدًا (`ر ء ي`, `ب ع د`); `70:7` نَرَاهُ قَرِيبًا (`ر ء ي`, `ق ر ب`); `70:10` حَمِيم (`ح م م`).
subchannels.synthesis: Near and far are judgments before they are coordinates. Sight, inward estimate, visible demonstration, and the coming-due of an affair explain how the same event can be projected away by one party and treated as imminent by another.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A remote-looking event is recalibrated by a higher scale whose route, duration, and endpoint make it near.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; `70:3-4` supplies the ascents and ascending, `70:4` the measured day of fifty thousand years, and `70:6-7` the far/near reversal.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The scale is not only numerical; it becomes a route with bends, halts, visible heights, and an endpoint that closes distance.

parent_channels.name: [P1 70:1-18] The Falling Event as Hydraulic Breach

subchannels.name: Rainfall, discharge, and catchment
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water falls, arrives in a single discharge, crowds into a surge, runs through outlets, and settles in catchments.
subchannels.active_motifs: falling rain `quranic:root_001675:B003/m01`; water-holding hollow `quranic:root_001675:B008/m01`; one burst of liquid `quranic:root_000480:B004/m01`; flood and wave surge `quranic:root_000480:B005/m01`; water channels and outfalls `quranic:root_000480:B006/m01`; flood barrier with measured release `quranic:root_000751:B007/m01`; mountain channel `quranic:root_001159:B006/m01`; waterskin `quranic:root_001212:B009/m01`; hot water and spring `quranic:root_000001:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Falling becomes a complete hydraulic sequence: precipitation, pulse, surge, channel, and basin. The hot-water motif converts an ordinary catchment into a punitive reservoir, while the mountain channel anticipates terrain that can no longer hold its form.

subchannels.name: Barrier and repeller failure
subchannels.scene_or_process: Protective works try to divert, delay, wall off, or stopper an arriving force, but the event is fixed and severe.
subchannels.active_motifs: diverting a harmful force `quranic:root_000480:B001/m01`; delaying a claim `quranic:root_000480:B008/m01`; controlled flood barrier `quranic:root_000751:B007/m01`; stopper for a vessel or well `quranic:root_000840:B018/m01`; covered mountain pass or low wall `quranic:root_001307:B013/m01`; short defensive wall `quranic:root_001159:B007/m01`; fixed falling occurrence `quranic:root_001675:B001/m01`; severe descending event `quranic:root_001675:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Diversion, postponement, gate, stopper, pass, and wall are successive control mechanisms. Their assembly sharpens “no repeller”: the failure is not lack of one heroic defender but the exhaustion of every ordinary means by which a flow is checked.

subchannels.name: Watering interval, thirst, and pre-birth flow
subchannels.scene_or_process: A herd approaches water on a counted cycle while thirst, irrigation, milk, and visible pregnancy regulate access to life-giving fluid.
subchannels.active_motifs: five-day camel watering cycle `quranic:root_000439:B003/m01`; alternating camel-water schedule `quranic:root_000997:B006/m01`; sweet potable water `quranic:root_000994:B001/m01`; abstention from food and drink `quranic:root_000994:B002/m01`; irrigation by drawing water `quranic:root_000751:B001/m01`; night approach to a water source `quranic:root_001212:B008/m01`; milk entering the udder before birth `quranic:root_000480:B009/m01`; visible animal pregnancy `quranic:root_000531:B010/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Counted time becomes a husbandry schedule rather than an abstraction. A thirsty herd, drawn irrigation, approach to the source, and milk arriving before birth form a life-maintaining cycle that the fifty-thousand-year measure radically enlarges.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: What falls moves like a fluid surge through channels, pools, and barriers until defenses cease to regulate it.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; `70:1-2` names a falling punishment with no repeller, while `70:8-9` supplies the liquefied sky and loosened mountains.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The punishment acquires the mechanics of rain, flood discharge, reservoirs, and failed waterworks.

parent_channels.name: [P1 70:1-18] Thermal Unmaking of Sky, Mountain, and Body

subchannels.name: Molten canopy and rendered fat
subchannels.scene_or_process: The overhead canopy becomes a molten compound while fat, grease, and metal lose their former boundaries.
subchannels.active_motifs: molten metal, oil dregs, and pitch-like liquid `quranic:root_001452:B003/m01`; melted fat `quranic:root_000001:B003/m01`; rendered grease `quranic:root_000260:B005/m01`; rump fat and flesh `quranic:root_000076:B015/m01`; overhead sky or canopy `quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`; occurrence and transformation in time `quranic:root_001332:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `70:4` كَان (`ك و ن`); `70:8` تَكُون، السَّمَاء، الْمُهْل (`ك و ن`, `س م و`, `م ه ل`); `70:5` جَمِيلًا (`ج م ل`); `70:10` حَمِيم (`ح م م`); surface anchor unavailable for `ء ل ي` at `70:4`.
subchannels.synthesis: The molten comparison opens into rendering and smelting: canopy, metal, oil sediment, and animal fat enter one phase change. The sky is not merely colored like melt; it behaves as matter whose internal distinctions have been cooked away.

subchannels.name: Mountain textile losing its seams
subchannels.scene_or_process: A massive, woven structure softens into dyed fiber and separates at its joints and decorative spacers.
subchannels.active_motifs: raised solid mass `quranic:root_000217:B001/m01`; thick bodily or geological form `quranic:root_000217:B003/m01`; tightly made weaving `quranic:root_000217:B007/m01`; softened but unsevered fracture `quranic:root_001056:B002/m01`; dyed wool `quranic:root_001056:B003/m01`; stitched hide or joined panels `quranic:root_000121:B006/m01`; bodily joint `quranic:root_001159:B005/m01`; beads separating pearls `quranic:root_001159:B012/m01`; gathered heavy cordage `quranic:root_000260:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Mountain solidity is reconstructed as textile engineering: thick mass, good weave, seam, joint, spacer, cord, and dyed wool. The collapse begins as soft fracture without clean separation, then proceeds by the failure of the joins that held the monumental fabric together.

subchannels.name: Roasting, stripping, and terminal residue
subchannels.scene_or_process: Heat cooks the body, extraction pulls it from its seat, and only a diminished remainder survives.
subchannels.active_motifs: roasting by heat `quranic:root_000830:B001/m01`; extremities and scalp `quranic:root_000830:B002/m01`; remaining scrap `quranic:root_000830:B004/m01`; pulling from a fixed place `quranic:root_001489:B001/m01`; receded hairline `quranic:root_001489:B007/m01`; death throes `quranic:root_001489:B016/m01`; punitive pain `quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`; dangling lash or strip `quranic:root_000994:B006/m01`; audible impact `quranic:root_001675:B004/m01`; sharpened blade `quranic:root_001675:B009/m01`; cutting and shearing `quranic:root_000239:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Roasting, blade impact, shearing, pulling, and scalp recession give the fire a precise dismantling sequence. The “extremities” are neither generic flesh nor an incidental detail: they are the nonfatal edges repeatedly removed until residue and death-throes converge.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Heat converts stable forms into melt, fiber, cooked flesh, and stripped residue.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; `70:8` compares the sky to molten matter, `70:9` the mountains to dyed wool, and `70:15-16` the fire strips the extremities.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Cosmic collapse is rendered through kitchen, foundry, textile, and anatomical operations.

parent_channels.name: [P1 70:1-18] Restraint, Enclosure, and the Loss of an Exit

subchannels.name: Beautiful inward restraint
subchannels.scene_or_process: The self remains held together by deliberate non-panic and withdrawal from an attached impulse.
subchannels.active_motifs: holding the self against panic `quranic:root_000840:B001/m01`; beautiful conduct `quranic:root_000260:B004/m01`; abstaining or weaning from a thing `quranic:root_000994:B003/m01`; ceasing after attachment `quranic:root_001489:B003/m01`; courage that does not leave its opponent `quranic:root_001390:B004/m01`; no alternative or turning away `quranic:root_001664:B006/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Patience is an active containment system: the self is held, appetite is weaned, attachment is released, and position is not abandoned. “Beautiful” names the quality of this controlled holding, not an ornamental mood.

subchannels.name: Coercive enclosure
subchannels.scene_or_process: A captive is fixed inside walls, armor, sheath, vessel, and shackle with no outlet.
subchannels.active_motifs: detention for execution or compelled oath `quranic:root_000840:B002/m01`; ordeal with no opening `quranic:root_000840:B006/m01`; hand-to-neck shackle `quranic:root_000259:B008/m01`; enclosing vessel `quranic:root_001664:B002/m01`; covering defense `quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`; armor or shield `quranic:root_000121:B005/m01`; sword sheath `quranic:root_001212:B010/m01`; short defensive wall `quranic:root_001159:B007/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The scene assembles progressively tighter boundaries: wall, armor, sheath, vessel, then shackle. What begins as protection changes role under judgment; every enclosure becomes part of confinement.

subchannels.name: Pressure sealed inside the body
subchannels.scene_or_process: A break, sore, or wound closes badly while heat and pus remain trapped within it.
subchannels.active_motifs: bone knitting after fracture, even crookedly `quranic:root_001664:B003/m01`; pus filling a wound `quranic:root_001664:B004/m01`; suppurating ulcer `quranic:root_000025:B011/m01`; saddle sore on the back `quranic:root_000458:B017/m01`; riding lesion `quranic:root_001675:B010/m01`; bodily fever `quranic:root_000001:B005/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Containment becomes pathological when closure preserves what should be discharged. A crookedly joined bone and a pus-filled sore mirror the hoard: both are accumulations sealed into a body until holding itself becomes injury.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Holding can be ethical self-command, protective enclosure, coercive confinement, or pathological pressure.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; `70:5` commands composed restraint, while `70:2`, `70:15-16`, and `70:18` progressively remove escape and close around what was gathered.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same holding operation moves from beautiful patience to stopper, wall, armor, shackle, sealed wound, and crookedly healed bone.

parent_channels.name: [P1 70:1-18] Kinship Converted into Ransom Inventory

subchannels.name: The sheltering intimate network
subchannels.scene_or_process: Affection and proximity bind child, spouse, sibling, clan, companion, and refuge into one protective network.
subchannels.active_motifs: affectionate close relative `quranic:root_000001:B011/m01`; sonship and descent `quranic:root_000156:B007/m01`; companionship and continual presence `quranic:root_000844:B001/m01`; preservation through companionship `quranic:root_000844:B002/m01`; grown son becoming companion `quranic:root_000844:B005/m01`; sibling kinship `quranic:root_000020:B001/m01`; tether or inviolable bond `quranic:root_000020:B002/m01`; near clan segment `quranic:root_001159:B009/m01`; sheltering convergence `quranic:root_000070:B001/m01`; merciful concern `quranic:root_000070:B002/m01`; blood-nearness `quranic:root_001212:B003/m01`; affection `quranic:root_001634:B001/m01`; loving alliance `quranic:root_001684:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The list is a functioning social architecture: love supplies motive, kinship supplies nearness, companionship supplies duration, the tether supplies obligation, clan supplies collective backing, and refuge supplies place. Ransom violates every role at once.

subchannels.name: Substitution, surety, and prisoner exchange
subchannels.scene_or_process: A liable person tries to place another life, property, or guarantor between himself and the penalty.
subchannels.active_motifs: sacrificial substitute `quranic:root_001136:B001/m01`; prisoner exchange `quranic:root_001136:B002/m01`; using another as protective ransom `quranic:root_001136:B003/m01`; diverting harm `quranic:root_000480:B001/m01`; ownership and disposal `quranic:root_001444:B002/m01`; effective capacity `quranic:root_001205:B003/m01`; surety and personal guarantee `quranic:root_000840:B003/m01`; undertaking care for another `quranic:root_001332:B003/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Ransom is a juridical mechanism rather than a vague wish: it requires a substitute, transferable control, capacity to tender it, and a surety accepted by the other side. “No repeller” means this proposed exchange has no receiving institution and no valid guarantor.

subchannels.name: Everyone and everything gathered as one lot
subchannels.scene_or_process: Distributed persons and goods are compressed into a complete, undivided offer.
subchannels.active_motifs: ground and all that is below the sky `quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`; thick woolen ground-covering `quranic:root_000025:B005/m01`; gathering dispersed things `quranic:root_000259:B001/m01`; assembled people or mixed host `quranic:root_000259:B002/m01`; undiminished totality `quranic:root_000259:B009/m01`; immense full container `quranic:root_000259:B012/m01`; comprehensive total `quranic:root_000260:B003/m01`; joining separated parts `quranic:root_000045:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: “Everyone on earth” is lexically materialized as mixed host, complete body, full vessel, and joined total. The proposed ransom thus grows from family substitutions into a single lot containing the inhabited world.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Relations that ordinarily shelter, love, and remain near are recoded as substitutable assets offered for one person's release.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; `70:10-14` moves through intimate, children, spouse, brother, clan, shelter, and everyone on earth as proposed ransom.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The family list becomes at once a household map, a surety system, a prisoner exchange, and a total inventory.

parent_channels.name: [P1 70:1-18] Question, Summons, and Failed Response

subchannels.name: Request, desired object, and mutual inquiry
subchannels.scene_or_process: An asker formulates a demand, names its desired object, seeks fulfillment, and may exchange questions with another.
subchannels.active_motifs: asking and requesting `quranic:root_000661:B001/m01`; desired object or need `quranic:root_000661:B002/m01`; satisfying a request `quranic:root_000661:B003/m01`; reciprocal questioning `quranic:root_000661:B004/m01`; interrogative or relative “what” `quranic:root_000527:B004/m01`; attention-seeking “tell me” `quranic:root_000531:B013/m01`; enigmatic question `quranic:root_000478:B007/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `70:1,10` سَأَل/سَائِل/يَسْأَل (`س ء ل`); `70:6-7` يَرَوْن/نَرَى (`ر ء ي`); `70:17` تَدْعُو (`د ع و`); surface anchor unavailable for `ذ و و` in `70:3`.
subchannels.synthesis: Asking unfolds into requester, sought object, possible fulfillment, and reciprocal dialogue. The interrogative and riddle motifs expose the structural reversal: the opening question is answered, but not through the social exchange that question normally initiates.

subchannels.name: The petitioner who is pushed away
subchannels.scene_or_process: A needy claimant is repelled, delayed, and excluded rather than having the request discharged.
subchannels.active_motifs: socially rejected petitioner `quranic:root_000480:B007/m01`; procrastinated claim `quranic:root_000480:B008/m01`; request for need `quranic:root_000661:B001/m01`; need fulfilled `quranic:root_000661:B003/m01`; emphatic negation `quranic:root_001390:B001/m01`; excluding exception `quranic:root_001390:B002/m01`; remote isolated settlement `quranic:root_001307:B012/m01`; mercy toward one seeking shelter `quranic:root_000070:B002/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `70:1,10` سَائِل/يَسْأَل (`س ء ل`); `70:2` لَيْس، دَافِع، كَافِرِين (`ل ي س`, `د ف ع`, `ك ف ر`); `70:13` تُؤْوِيه (`ء و ي`).
subchannels.synthesis: The no-repeller formula acquires a social underside: a petitioner is physically pushed aside, a claim is stalled, and negation closes the case. The opening asker and the later failure of intimates to ask are held together by the collapse of ordinary petition.

subchannels.name: Calling down the event
subchannels.scene_or_process: A voice calls toward a target, invokes harm, and is followed by one collapse after another.
subchannels.active_motifs: vocal summons `quranic:root_000478:B001/m01`; calling down harm `quranic:root_000478:B004/m01`; successive falling or demolition `quranic:root_000478:B005/m01`; vicissitudes that pull a person `quranic:root_000478:B006/m01`; severe descending event `quranic:root_001675:B002/m01`; extermination without remnant `quranic:root_000458:B004/m01`; surviving remainder `quranic:root_000830:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The fire's call is both voice and causation. Invocation is followed by sequential collapse, while the polarity between total extermination and residual scrap defines what remains after the summons reaches those who turned away.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Speech seeks, calls, or demands a response, but the only effective answer is the event itself.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; asking frames `70:1`, mutual asking fails in `70:10`, and the fire calls in `70:17`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Petition, riddle, curse, legal claim, and cascading collapse become alternate forms of a summons that cannot be negotiated.

parent_channels.name: [P1 70:1-18] Visibility, Bodily Evidence, and Inscribed Judgment

subchannels.name: Forced mutual visibility
subchannels.scene_or_process: Observers face one another and are made to see what their prior estimate displaced.
subchannels.active_motifs: sensory and inward sight `quranic:root_000531:B001/m01`; considered perception `quranic:root_000531:B002/m01`; mutual facing within sight `quranic:root_000531:B004/m01`; mirror and visible aspect `quranic:root_000531:B006/m01`; making another see `quranic:root_000531:B012/m01`; ocular vision `quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`; inward discernment `quranic:root_000121:B002/m01`; waiting for what is expected `quranic:root_001675:B012/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Seeing progresses from perception, to estimate, to mutual facing, to compelled display. The mirror motif removes the safety of a one-sided gaze: the criminal sees the relatives and, in the same scene, becomes visible to them.

subchannels.name: Mark, division, and written closure
subchannels.scene_or_process: A matter is made legible by banner, articulated speech, textual segmentation, detail, and a final written mark.
subchannels.active_motifs: visible standard `quranic:root_000531:B011/m01`; tongue that distinguishes matters `quranic:root_001159:B004/m01`; textual and metrical divisions `quranic:root_001159:B011/m01`; analytic detailing `quranic:root_001159:B013/m01`; grammatical separator `quranic:root_001159:B015/m01`; signature or marginal notation `quranic:root_001675:B011/m01`; projected voice `quranic:root_000239:B008/m01`; alphabetic letter `quranic:root_000045:B006/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Judgment becomes an act of legibility. A standard points, a tongue distinguishes, divisions organize, detail discloses components, and a signature closes the record. The relatives listed in discrete sequence read like the articulated sections of the criminal's liability.

subchannels.name: Blood trace as testimony
subchannels.scene_or_process: Bodily fluid lands, leaves a visible trace, and records the force that produced it.
subchannels.active_motifs: blood trace on body or ground `quranic:root_000121:B004/m01`; menstrual sign distinguishing states `quranic:root_000531:B007/m01`; one discharge of blood or liquid `quranic:root_000480:B004/m01`; impact mark and sound `quranic:root_001675:B004/m01`; cutting offense `quranic:root_000239:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Vision is not confined to an eye. A fluid sign and a blood-mark preserve an event on the body or ground, while the impact supplies its cause. The scene turns punishment into evidence that can be inspected rather than denied.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: What was estimated, hidden, or relationally ignored is made perceptible through sight, marks, seams, blood, and text.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; `70:6-7` stages rival seeing and `70:11` forcibly makes the parties see one another.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Visual disclosure extends into mirror, banner, blood trace, stitched edge, textual division, and signature.

parent_channels.name: [P1 70:1-18] Reversal, Pursuit, and the End of the Remnant

subchannels.name: Face, back, and estrangement
subchannels.scene_or_process: A participant reverses orientation, puts the call behind him, and breaks proximity with the other side.
subchannels.active_motifs: rear side `quranic:root_000458:B001/m01`; terminal part or aftermath `quranic:root_000458:B002/m01`; showing the back and retreating `quranic:root_000458:B003/m01`; mutual back-turning and estrangement `quranic:root_000458:B005/m01`; adjacent nearness `quranic:root_001684:B001/m01`; turning the face toward `quranic:root_001684:B006/m01`; turning away `quranic:root_001684:B007/m01`; what follows after `quranic:root_000131:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The two roots in `70:17` form a complete orientation grammar: face toward, remain adjacent, reverse, present the back, and break relation. The sequence explains why the fire's call is directed not at a stationary object but at someone whose movement is already an answer.

subchannels.name: Movement converging on a terminal point
subchannels.scene_or_process: Rapid motion, succession, and pursuit converge on a limit that is reached and possessed.
subchannels.active_motifs: forceful movement toward a goal `quranic:root_000480:B003/m01`; released running `quranic:root_001489:B012/m01`; uninterrupted succession `quranic:root_001684:B002/m01`; reaching and taking the goal `quranic:root_001684:B012/m01`; terminal limit `quranic:root_000076:B001/m01`; vocal attraction toward a place `quranic:root_000478:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `70:2` دَافِع (`د ف ع`); `70:16` نَزَّاعَة (`ن ز ع`); `70:17` تَدْعُو، تَوَلَّى (`د ع و`, `و ل ي`); surface anchor unavailable for `ء ل ي` in `70:4`.
subchannels.synthesis: Retreat does not open indefinite distance. Motion follows motion without a gap, the endpoint is reached, and the call functions like a directional force. The terminal preposition motif makes the pursuit grammatically as well as physically convergent.

subchannels.name: Cutting off the last trace
subchannels.scene_or_process: Death, banishment, and extraction proceed until no successor or remnant remains.
subchannels.active_motifs: eradication of a people's last trace `quranic:root_000458:B004/m01`; surviving scrap `quranic:root_000830:B004/m01`; banishment into destruction `quranic:root_000131:B004/m01`; death as release `quranic:root_000609:B016/m01`; decreed death `quranic:root_000001:B010/m01`; terminal death-pull `quranic:root_001489:B016/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The active contrast is between a leftover piece and the cutting of the last trace. Death is rendered as decree, release, and final extraction, so the pursuing call ends not merely in capture but in removal of continuity.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Turning one's back initiates a directional sequence in which the rejected call becomes the pursuing endpoint.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; `70:17` joins the fire's call to turning back and turning away.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Front/back orientation expands into route succession, chase, failed escape, and eradication of the last trace.

parent_channels.name: [P1 70:1-18] Hoard as Vessel, Fist, and Shackle

subchannels.name: Compressing a dispersed stock
subchannels.scene_or_process: Goods from separate places are gathered, gripped, completed, and put into a container.
subchannels.active_motifs: gathering dispersed property `quranic:root_000259:B001/m01`; closed fist and handful `quranic:root_000259:B005/m01`; intact undiminished whole `quranic:root_000259:B009/m01`; force or flow gathering itself `quranic:root_000259:B010/m01`; great full vessel `quranic:root_000259:B012/m01`; enclosing goods in a vessel `quranic:root_001664:B002/m01`; many persons collected together `quranic:root_001664:B008/m01`; comprehensive sum `quranic:root_000260:B003/m01`; joining separated pieces `quranic:root_000045:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Gathering proceeds through increasingly compact states: dispersed stock, collective mass, complete whole, handful, and sealed vessel. The hoard is therefore a spatial operation of reducing plurality to an interior under one holder's control.

subchannels.name: Stored value hardens into restraint
subchannels.scene_or_process: The enclosing equipment of storage changes function and binds its owner.
subchannels.active_motifs: hand-to-neck iron `quranic:root_000259:B008/m01`; crookedly healed bone `quranic:root_001664:B003/m01`; no alternative exit `quranic:root_001664:B006/m01`; vessel or well stopper `quranic:root_000840:B018/m01`; enclosing sword sheath `quranic:root_001212:B010/m01`; heavy gathered rope `quranic:root_000260:B002/m01`; stitched enclosure `quranic:root_000121:B006/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Rope, seam, sheath, stopper, and vessel are ordinary holding technologies. Their culmination in a shackle reveals the pressure within the hoard: the apparatus used to retain wealth becomes the apparatus that retains the person.

subchannels.name: Wealth, collusion, and obsessive possession
subchannels.scene_or_process: Property is acquired, guarded by alliance, and pursued until engagement with it becomes compulsive.
subchannels.active_motifs: enduring large estate `quranic:root_000458:B016/m01`; ownership and disposal `quranic:root_001444:B002/m01`; collusive assembly around an affair `quranic:root_000259:B013/m01`; obsessive immersion in a matter `quranic:root_000480:B011/m01`; gain and acquisition `quranic:root_000239:B003/m01`; gathered food-stock or marketable dates `quranic:root_001136:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The hoard is sustained socially as well as materially: acquisition feeds an estate, allies coordinate around it, and the possessor becomes engrossed in its defense. That network explains why accumulation can compete with every prior kinship claim.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Accumulation compresses dispersed value into a controlled interior, but the same enclosing operation converts possession into restraint.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; `70:18` joins gathering to putting away.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The hoard takes the forms of fist, full vessel, rope, stopper, healed fracture, and hand-to-neck iron.

parent_channels.name: [P1 70:1-18] Caravan Order and the Wounded Mount

subchannels.name: Herd, leader, and return
subchannels.scene_or_process: A collected herd follows a leading animal and returns toward its managed resting place.
subchannels.active_motifs: camel herd with keepers `quranic:root_000260:B001/m01`; large camel group `quranic:root_000997:B005/m01`; leading animal followed by the rest `quranic:root_001444:B008/m01`; livestock returning in the afternoon `quranic:root_000609:B005/m01`; animals kneeling to rest `quranic:root_001675:B007/m01`; capable management of livestock wealth `quranic:root_001056:B007/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The ascent is reframed as a managed procession: herd, leader, keepers, timed return, and kneeling place. Order depends on following the guide; turning away from the ordered line in `70:17` is therefore a pastoral as well as moral dislocation.

subchannels.name: Route, tack, and abrasion
subchannels.scene_or_process: A mount follows the center of a route with water enough for travel, protected by tack that nonetheless produces sores.
subchannels.active_motifs: ship-rope or heavy lead cord `quranic:root_000260:B002/m01`; saddle underlay `quranic:root_001684:B011/m01`; saddle sore `quranic:root_000458:B017/m01`; riding abrasion `quranic:root_001675:B010/m01`; centerline of road or valley `quranic:root_001444:B006/m01`; water that sustains a traveler `quranic:root_001444:B007/m01`; prepared honored mount `quranic:root_001212:B013/m01`; camel exempted from burden `quranic:root_000480:B010/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Route and tack distribute a journey's load: centerline guides, water sustains, underlay cushions, and an honored mount is spared work. The paired riding sores expose the failure of that distribution under extreme duration: what carries the procession is itself marked by the passage.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A herd survives by ordered leadership, water, route, and tack, yet the same journey leaves the bearing animal abraded and spent.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the ascent, vast duration, mountains, turning, and gathering in `70:3-18` activate a long-distance pastoral route.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The procession includes a herd leader, valley centerline, water reserve, honored mount, saddle underlay, and paired riding wounds.

parent_channels.name: [P1 70:1-18] Gestation, Weaning, and the Severed Offspring Bond

subchannels.name: Mating, pregnancy, and pre-birth provision
subchannels.scene_or_process: A male mounts, pregnancy becomes visible, birth approaches, and milk enters the udder in advance.
subchannels.active_motifs: stallion mounting a herd `quranic:root_000745:B003/m01`; male camel covering the female `quranic:root_000751:B010/m01`; horse becoming breeding male `quranic:root_000609:B018/m01`; visible animal pregnancy `quranic:root_000531:B010/m01`; imminent birth `quranic:root_001212:B012/m01`; milk before parturition `quranic:root_000480:B009/m01`; uterine vessels `quranic:root_001056:B005/m01`; womb and post-birth discharge `quranic:root_000994:B009/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Reproduction is a causal chain rather than a family label: mating, conception, visible swelling, approaching birth, uterine structure, and anticipatory milk. The son's presence in `70:11` carries this whole material history, intensifying the violence of offering him as an exchange object.

subchannels.name: Separation by weaning and maturation
subchannels.scene_or_process: The young is separated from the mother, then grows until it can stand beside the parent as a companion.
subchannels.active_motifs: young camel separated from mother and milk `quranic:root_001159:B003/m01`; young livestock separated until compliant `quranic:root_001684:B015/m01`; son maturing into companion `quranic:root_000844:B005/m01`; offspring and descent `quranic:root_000156:B007/m01`; small offshoots named as daughters or sons `quranic:root_000156:B008/m01`; food building flesh `quranic:root_000156:B010/m01`; formed bodily structure `quranic:root_000156:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Separation is normally developmental: the young leaves milk, grows flesh and structure, and becomes a companion. Ransom deforms that process by treating mature relational independence as permission to sever obligation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Life is joined through mating and gestation, then differentiated through birth, weaning, and maturation.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; `70:11-13` names sons and the near clan precisely where the criminal wishes to reverse the life-cycle bond.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The family list expands into animal breeding, visible pregnancy, uterine tissue, milk-before-birth, weaning, and the adult child becoming a companion.

parent_channels.name: [P1 70:1-18] Cultivation, Cutting, and the Hoarded Harvest

subchannels.name: Soil, rain, and emerging growth
subchannels.scene_or_process: Rain reaches fertile ground, plants root and unfold, while dry growth marks the opposite state.
subchannels.active_motifs: fertile planted earth `quranic:root_000025:B002/m01`; rainfall `quranic:root_001675:B003/m01`; leaf and aromatic plant `quranic:root_000609:B012/m01`; tree bursting into leaf `quranic:root_000609:B017/m01`; named herb `quranic:root_001489:B015/m01`; dry tree `quranic:root_000217:B008/m01`; green tanning shrub `quranic:root_000076:B005/m01`; medicinal senna plant `quranic:root_000751:B005/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `70:1` وَاقِع (`و ق ع`); `70:4` الرُّوح، سَنَة (`ر و ح`, `س ن و`); `70:9` الْجِبَال (`ج ب ل`); `70:14` الْأَرْض (`ء ر ض`); `70:16` نَزَّاعَة (`ن ز ع`); surface anchor unavailable for `ء ل ي` at `70:4`.
subchannels.synthesis: The earth is not inert inventory. It receives rain, holds rooted growth, opens leaves, and yields named plants; drought produces the dry-tree counterstate. Offering “all on earth” would therefore consume a productive ecology, not merely a territorial expanse.

subchannels.name: Covering seed and governing water
subchannels.scene_or_process: Seed is covered, fruit remains sheathed, and irrigation is admitted through regulated barriers into protected catchments.
subchannels.active_motifs: sowing by covering seed `quranic:root_001307:B008/m01`; fruit sheath `quranic:root_001307:B010/m01`; drawing irrigation water `quranic:root_000751:B001/m01`; flood-control barrier `quranic:root_000751:B007/m01`; water-holding ground `quranic:root_001675:B008/m01`; raised ground above flood `quranic:root_001476:B004/m01`; mountain watercourse `quranic:root_001159:B006/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Productive enclosure differs from hoarding: soil covers seed to germinate, a sheath protects fruit, and a barrier releases only needed water. These regulated containers expose the moral defect of accumulation in `70:18`, which closes without a life-giving outlet.

subchannels.name: Cutting, gleaning, and piling
subchannels.scene_or_process: Mature growth is cut, residual dates are gleaned, palm stock is propagated, and food is amassed into an unmeasured pile.
subchannels.active_motifs: cutting fruit and shearing `quranic:root_000239:B001/m01`; dates left after harvest `quranic:root_000239:B002/m01`; seed-grown date palms of mixed kind `quranic:root_000259:B011/m01`; transplanted palm shoot `quranic:root_001159:B016/m01`; piled food sold without measure `quranic:root_000840:B011/m01`; gathered dates or grain `quranic:root_001136:B004/m01`; taking the whole stock `quranic:root_000751:B009/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Harvest separates crop from plant, then recovers leftovers and gathers them into a pile. The final “taking the whole stock” motif turns gleaning's residual economy into total appropriation, aligning the harvest scene tightly with the hoarder.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Rain and soil produce covered growth that is cut, sorted, and gathered into post-harvest stock.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the sky and mountains of `70:8-9`, the whole earth of `70:14`, and gathering in `70:18` provide the scene's weather, terrain, and terminal operation.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The hoard resembles a crop economy whose seed-covering, irrigation, palm propagation, cutting, gleaning, drying, and piling have been detached from redistribution.

parent_channels.name: [P1 70:1-18] Animated Body, Suppurating Wound, and Death-Pull

subchannels.name: Breath within an assembled frame
subchannels.scene_or_process: Life inhabits a structured body whose lungs, torso, and extremities remain perceptible.
subchannels.active_motifs: life-giving spirit `quranic:root_000609:B001/m01`; lung and its ailments `quranic:root_000531:B009/m01`; bodily mass `quranic:root_000239:B007/m01`; composed bodily structure `quranic:root_000156:B002/m01`; extremities and scalp `quranic:root_000830:B002/m01`; rump flesh `quranic:root_000076:B015/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `70:4` الرُّوح (`ر و ح`); `70:6-7` يَرَوْن/نَرَى (`ر ء ي`); `70:11` الْمُجْرِم، بَنِيه (`ج ر م`, `ب ن ي`); `70:16` الشَّوَى (`ش و ي`); surface anchor unavailable for `ء ل ي` in `70:4`.
subchannels.synthesis: The body appears as a composed frame animated by spirit and breathing through lung. Naming the extremities against that whole makes stripping a disassembly of a living architecture, not a generic image of pain.

subchannels.name: Heat, sweat, sore, and pus
subchannels.scene_or_process: Heat produces sweat and fever; repeated bearing opens sores that retain corrupt fluid.
subchannels.active_motifs: sweat under heat `quranic:root_000001:B004/m01`; bodily fever `quranic:root_000001:B005/m01`; saddle lesion `quranic:root_000458:B017/m01`; riding abrasion `quranic:root_001675:B010/m01`; suppurating ulcer `quranic:root_000025:B011/m01`; pus-filled wound `quranic:root_001664:B004/m01`; blood trace `quranic:root_000121:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The bodily scene converts judgment's heat into a medical process: sweat, fever, abrasion, ulcer, pus, and visible blood. Accumulation returns here as trapped corrupt matter, joining the wounded body to the sealed hoard.

subchannels.name: Animation withdrawn
subchannels.scene_or_process: The body reaches an inescapable terminal state in which life is released and pulled out.
subchannels.active_motifs: death named as release `quranic:root_000609:B016/m01`; decreed mortality `quranic:root_000001:B010/m01`; terminal death-pull `quranic:root_001489:B016/m01`; captive fixed for killing `quranic:root_000840:B002/m01`; escape by separation `quranic:root_001476:B001/m01`; severe ordeal with no outlet `quranic:root_000840:B006/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Release is double-edged: rescue would separate a person from danger, while death releases spirit from body. The no-outlet ordeal collapses those alternatives, leaving extraction of life as the only completed separation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: The living body is an assembled form sustained by breath, then marked by heat and injury before animation is withdrawn.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; `70:11` exposes the embodied criminal and `70:16` names the body's extremities as the fire's object.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Breath, lung, bodily frame, fever, sweat, saddle sore, pus, and death-throe form a complete deterioration sequence.

parent_channels.name: [P1 70:1-18] Sovereign Capacity, Crime, and Unaccepted Surety

subchannels.name: Dominion able to execute a measured decree
subchannels.scene_or_process: A sovereign owns, measures, plans, and brings an event into occurrence.
subchannels.active_motifs: worshipped deity `quranic:root_000047:B001/m01`; divine name in invocation and oath `quranic:root_000047:B002/m01`; kingship and dominion `quranic:root_001444:B003/m01`; effective capacity `quranic:root_001205:B003/m01`; deliberate calibration `quranic:root_001205:B005/m01`; event occurring in time `quranic:root_001332:B001/m01`; governance and charge `quranic:root_001684:B003/m01`; entitlement and priority `quranic:root_001684:B008/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The source of punishment is specified through the operational vocabulary of rule: deity, dominion, capacity, measurement, planning, occurrence, and charge. The decree is unstoppable because it is already within an executable order.

subchannels.name: Adjudication and criminal liability
subchannels.scene_or_process: An offense is identified, judgment separates truth from false claim, and retribution reaches completion.
subchannels.active_motifs: decisive judgment `quranic:root_001159:B002/m01`; offense and criminality `quranic:root_000239:B004/m01`; gain that incurs responsibility `quranic:root_000239:B003/m01`; fixed obligation `quranic:root_001675:B001/m01`; severe judicial event `quranic:root_001675:B002/m01`; retributive equivalence `quranic:root_000840:B012/m01`; decreed outcome `quranic:root_000001:B010/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Crime is linked to acquisition, then passed through decisive separation and equivalent requital. The falling event is thus a judgment that has moved from liability to execution, not an unclassified catastrophe.

subchannels.name: Surety that cannot answer
subchannels.scene_or_process: Owner, guarantor, and protector are all proposed, but none has standing to discharge the claim.
subchannels.active_motifs: personal surety `quranic:root_000840:B003/m01`; undertaking another's charge `quranic:root_001332:B003/m01`; ownership and transferable control `quranic:root_001444:B002/m01`; diversion of harm `quranic:root_000480:B001/m01`; emphatic absence `quranic:root_001390:B001/m01`; fulfilling a petition `quranic:root_000661:B003/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The legal scene tests each possible answer to liability: surety, custodian, owner, defender, and satisfied claimant. Emphatic negation rejects the entire chain, which is why even universal ransom in `70:14` remains ineffective.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A fixed penalty issues from effective dominion, distinguishes liability, and cannot be neutralized by private ownership or guarantee.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; `70:1-4` grounds the event in God, `70:11` identifies the criminal, and `70:2,11-14` deny defense and ransom.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Divine title, royal rule, calibrated design, adjudication, criminal gain, surety, and retribution form one legal order.

parent_channels.name: [P1 70:1-18] Covering, Refuge, and Exposure to the Sky

subchannels.name: Layered protective covers
subchannels.scene_or_process: A body or valuable object is wrapped by textile, armor, sheath, canopy, and enclosing wall.
subchannels.active_motifs: material covering `quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`; darkness or broad water as cover `quranic:root_001307:B002/m01`; fruit sheath `quranic:root_001307:B010/m01`; covered mountain pass `quranic:root_001307:B013/m01`; covering crown `quranic:root_001307:B015/m01`; overhead canopy `quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`; leather tent or spread `quranic:root_000156:B004/m01`; armor `quranic:root_000121:B005/m01`; blade sheath `quranic:root_001212:B010/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Protection is built in layers from sheath and armor to tent, wall, mountain pass, and sky. The crown adds status to shelter, showing that covering guards both body and rank before the molten canopy invalidates both.

subchannels.name: Refuge without overhead screen
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person seeks house, elevated ground, or walled shelter, yet remains exposed directly to the sky.
subchannels.active_motifs: uncovered exposure to heaven `quranic:root_000994:B004/m01`; converging into shelter `quranic:root_000070:B001/m01`; short defensive wall `quranic:root_001159:B007/m01`; clinging low to the ground `quranic:root_000025:B006/m01`; flood-safe elevation `quranic:root_001476:B004/m01`; elevated cloud or ground `quranic:root_001675:B016/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Refuge ranges from crouching at ground level to entering a wall and climbing above flood. The uncovered-to-sky motif defeats the whole vertical spectrum: neither low attachment nor high escape restores a protective interval.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Covering can shelter, conceal, or dignify, but judgment removes the interval between a body and the exposed heavens.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the overhead sky in `70:8`, sheltering clan in `70:13`, and failed rescue in `70:14` activate the contrast.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Canopy, garment, fruit sheath, armor, tent, mountain pass, and high refuge all test distinct ways of being covered.

parent_channels.name: [P1 70:1-18] Tension, Release, and Audible Impact

subchannels.name: Bow under draw
subchannels.scene_or_process: A curved body adheres to its string, the string is drawn, and stored tension is aimed.
subchannels.active_motifs: drawing a bowstring `quranic:root_001489:B002/m01`; bow adhering dangerously to its string `quranic:root_000156:B005/m01`; extraction tool or arrow `quranic:root_001489:B010/m01`; sword or knife sheath `quranic:root_001212:B010/m01`; heavy cord `quranic:root_000260:B002/m01`; tether loop `quranic:root_000020:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The scene holds potential force before release: curved bow, clinging string, drawn cord, arrow, and sheath. It materially reframes patience as controlled tension and the fire's stripping as the violent release of that stored pull.

subchannels.name: Flight, strike, and penetration
subchannels.scene_or_process: A sharpened projectile travels, strikes audibly, and either penetrates, overshoots, or leaves a bodily mark.
subchannels.active_motifs: sharpened iron or blade `quranic:root_001675:B009/m01`; audible blow `quranic:root_001675:B004/m01`; battlefield strike `quranic:root_001675:B005/m01`; arrow passing beyond its target `quranic:root_000458:B018/m01`; losing cast or failed arrow `quranic:root_000458:B019/m01`; blood trace `quranic:root_000121:B004/m01`; pulling an object from its seat `quranic:root_001489:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Impact is decomposed into edge, flight, sound, strike, target relation, and wound trace. The contrast between overshooting and penetrating clarifies the eschatological event's precision: unlike a lost cast, it finds and extracts its object.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Stored force is drawn into a cord or weapon, released in flight, and registered as penetration, sound, and bodily extraction.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; `70:1` names impact as an arriving event and `70:16` gives it a pulling action upon the body.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Bow, adhered string, arrow, sheath, sharpening stone, target, and missed shot supply a compact weapon mechanism.

parent_channels.name: [P2 70:19-44] Contact-Triggered Human Instability

subchannels.name: A disposition built into the form
subchannels.scene_or_process: A human form is measured and composed together with an inward nature predisposed toward agitation.
subchannels.active_motifs: human presence opposed to wildness `quranic:root_000059:B001/m01`; sociable nearness that removes isolation `quranic:root_000059:B003/m01`; inward-facing side `quranic:root_000059:B004/m01`; creative production `quranic:root_000434:B002/m01`; completed bodily form `quranic:root_000434:B003/m01`; inward disposition `quranic:root_000434:B004/m01`; aptitude or predisposition `quranic:root_000434:B005/m01`; greedy panic and rapid agitation `quranic:root_001595:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `70:19` الْإِنْسَان، خُلِق، هَلُوعًا (`ء ن س`, `خ ل ق`, `ه ل ع`).
subchannels.synthesis: The verse's ethical description is grounded in formed nature: human sociality, bodily completion, inner side, disposition, and aptitude. Agitation is not treated as a passing label; it is a response tendency lodged in the creature's design.

subchannels.name: Harm crosses and breaks composure

subchannels.synthesis: Harm is a crossing force: it contacts, cuts, and leaves a reduced remainder. Panic is the internal analogue of the broken span, the moment when endurance no longer carries the person across adversity.

subchannels.name: Benefit meets a fortified hand
subchannels.scene_or_process: Desired good reaches the person but is stopped by a hand, barrier, and defensive power.

subchannels.synthesis: Withholding is built as a defended threshold: good arrives as transferable benefit, but the giver's hand becomes barrier, fortification, and contestant. Scarcity is therefore produced by control, not merely suffered as lack.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Human disposition changes abruptly when an external condition touches it: harm fractures composure, while benefit triggers withholding.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; `70:19-21` names the created disposition, contact with harm, panic, contact with good, and refusal.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Temperament becomes material design, bodily contact, transverse cutting, a broken span, and a fortified hand.

parent_channels.name: [P2 70:19-44] Prayer as Stable Station and Recurrent Guard

subchannels.name: Standing in a stable orbit
subchannels.scene_or_process: The worshipper repeatedly enters an oriented station, stands, and remains there through time.

subchannels.name: Vigilant maintenance of the course

subchannels.name: Invocation answered by affirmation

subchannels.synthesis: The ritual station also has a discourse structure: invocation seeks an answer, affirmation ratifies it, oath binds it, and testimony carries it publicly. Constancy thus joins bodily recurrence to dependable speech.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Repeated embodied observance turns unstable response into duration, orientation, and vigilant maintenance.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; `70:22-23` names prayer and constancy, and `70:34` returns to guarding prayer.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Prayer forms a station with direction, posture, orbit, watch, straight path, and a speaking act of blessing.

parent_channels.name: [P2 70:19-44] The Known Right as a Distributive Measure

subchannels.name: Fixed title, mark, and share
subchannels.scene_or_process: A claim is identified, marked, measured, and assigned from a privately held stock.
subchannels.active_motifs: accumulation of property `quranic:root_001457:B001/m01`; binding entitlement `quranic:root_000347:B002/m01`; privately held right `quranic:root_000347:B003/m01`; establishing a claim `quranic:root_000347:B005/m01`; fitting joint or container `quranic:root_000347:B011/m01`; known information `quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`; visible identifying mark `quranic:root_001040:B002/m01`; apportioned share `quranic:root_001226:B003/m01`; allotted portion `quranic:root_001507:B005/m01`; fixed threshold and basis `quranic:root_001507:B006/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The share is “known” because it has legal and perceptual form: title establishes it, measurement bounds it, a mark identifies it, and a fitting joint locates it within the whole estate. Distribution is the correct placement of a part, not discretionary generosity.

subchannels.name: Claimant, deprived person, and open provision
subchannels.scene_or_process: A requester approaches, a deprived person lacks access, and wealth exits as alms or generous hospitality.
subchannels.active_motifs: requester `quranic:root_000661:B001/m01`; desired need `quranic:root_000661:B002/m01`; discharged petition `quranic:root_000661:B003/m01`; inviolable claim `quranic:root_000313:B006/m01`; deprivation from hoped-for provision `quranic:root_000313:B008/m01`; alms as truthful transfer `quranic:root_000852:B006/m01`; gift and generosity `quranic:root_000452:B005/m01`; noble generosity `quranic:root_001294:B001/m01`; a host crowded by guests and askers `quranic:root_000606:B006/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The claimant scene has both legal and household dimensions. Right protects the request, alms moves property outward, and hospitality receives the approaching person. Generosity is not opposed to obligation; it is the social form in which obligation becomes provision.

subchannels.name: Manufactured scarcity
subchannels.scene_or_process: A holder narrows provision, reduces the gift, and invokes prohibition or difference to keep the claimant outside.
subchannels.active_motifs: refusal to give `quranic:root_001448:B001/m01`; meager or inferior gift `quranic:root_000803:B001/m01`; miserly reduction `quranic:root_000803:B004/m01`; narrowed provision `quranic:root_001205:B004/m01`; prohibition `quranic:root_000313:B001/m01`; deprivation `quranic:root_000313:B008/m01`; exception and exclusion `quranic:root_001119:B005/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Scarcity is assembled through deliberate operations: narrow, diminish, prohibit, exclude, and withhold. These motifs pressure the description of human refusal by showing how abundance can be made inaccessible without ceasing to exist.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Wealth becomes legitimate when a visible, fixed share leaves private possession and reaches a claimant.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; `70:24-25` identifies a known right in wealth for the asker and deprived.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The right behaves as title, joint, measured share, public mark, outgoing revenue, and hospitality at a crowded door.

parent_channels.name: [P2 70:19-44] Debt, Promise, and the Appointed Settlement

subchannels.name: Account and enforceable claim
subchannels.scene_or_process: A debt is entered, its truth contested or established, and judgment calculates what is due.
subchannels.active_motifs: reckoning and recompense `quranic:root_000504:B002/m01`; financial debt and deferred sale `quranic:root_000504:B003/m01`; accepting a person's legal oath `quranic:root_000504:B007/m01`; truth matching reality `quranic:root_000347:B001/m01`; binding obligation `quranic:root_000347:B002/m01`; adversarial claim to right `quranic:root_000347:B004/m01`; truthful statement `quranic:root_000852:B001/m01`; fulfillment in action `quranic:root_000852:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The day of judgment is a settlement scene: debt supplies the outstanding claim, truth supplies the valid record, contest tests it, and recompense closes the account. Belief in the day is accordingly a present recognition of enforceable liability.

subchannels.name: Trust and reciprocal undertaking
subchannels.scene_or_process: A promise enters custody, becomes a covenant between parties, and awaits faithful performance.
subchannels.active_motifs: entrusted security `quranic:root_000054:B001/m01`; heart-settled belief `quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`; protected covenant `quranic:root_001055:B003/m01`; commitment opening expectation `quranic:root_001662:B001/m01`; fixed time or place of promise `quranic:root_001662:B003/m01`; reciprocal promising `quranic:root_001662:B004/m01`; performed commitment `quranic:root_000852:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Promise is not only information about the future. It is deposited as trust, ratified as covenant, shared between parties, and located at a due time. The repeated promised day is the date on which custody turns into performance.

subchannels.name: Threat arriving at its appointment
subchannels.scene_or_process: Warning signs intensify until the addressee meets the harmful event at its stated time.
subchannels.active_motifs: threatening warning `quranic:root_001662:B002/m01`; stallion's warning before attack `quranic:root_001662:B005/m01`; signs promising a coming condition `quranic:root_001662:B006/m01`; face-to-face encounter `quranic:root_001372:B004/m01`; experienced adversity `quranic:root_001372:B007/m01`; catastrophic day `quranic:root_001700:B003/m01`; punitive pain `quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`; sovereign owner `quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `70:27-28` عَذَاب رَبِّهِم (`ع ذ ب`, `ر ب ب`); `70:42` يُلَاقُوا يَوْمَهُم الَّذِي يُوعَدُون (`ل ق ي`, `ي و م`, `و ع د`); `70:44` الْيَوْم الَّذِي كَانُوا يُوعَدُون (`ي و م`, `و ع د`).
subchannels.synthesis: Threat develops like an animal warning before charge: a signal, a voiced menace, advancing harm, then encounter. The promised day is not merely reached on a calendar; it meets the person as an experienced event.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A future claim binds the present through debt, truthful commitment, trust, and a fixed time of encounter.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; `70:26` names the day of settlement, `70:28` denies security, and `70:42-44` repeats the promised day until it is met.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Eschatological promise becomes a ledger of loan, entitlement, mutual undertaking, due date, and collection.

parent_channels.name: [P2 70:19-44] Fear Before Judgment and Humiliation After It

subchannels.name: Apprehension without a safe guarantee
subchannels.scene_or_process: Concern attends a danger because no promise of immunity can be relied upon.
subchannels.active_motifs: protective concern mixed with fear `quranic:root_000803:B003/m01`; heart at rest under security `quranic:root_000054:B001/m01`; negation and exception `quranic:root_001119:B005/m01`; punitive pain `quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`; sovereign owner `quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`; corrective oversight `quranic:root_000532:B002/m01`; twilight between light and dark `quranic:root_000803:B002/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: `70:27` عَذَاب رَبِّهِم مُشْفِقُون (`ع ذ ب`, `ر ب ب`, `ش ف ق`); `70:28` غَيْر مَأْمُون (`غ ي ر`, `ء م ن`).
subchannels.synthesis: Fear is neither panic nor ignorance. It is attentive care at a twilight boundary, where danger is discernible but immunity is unavailable. Security would quiet the heart; its explicit negation keeps vigilance active.

subchannels.name: Pressure that closes over the body
subchannels.scene_or_process: A pursuing burden catches the person, overwhelms him, lowers his profile, and leaves him under imposed disgrace.

subchannels.synthesis: Humiliation is a force with direction and load. It catches, imposes weight, drives the body down, removes the hump's proud height, and makes the person receive blows like a peg. The abstract noun becomes visible posture.

subchannels.name: Eye, horizon, and sinking light
subchannels.scene_or_process: A fixed forward gaze gives way to streaming eyes, sinking celestial bodies, and lowered sight.
subchannels.active_motifs: ocular sight `quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`; inward discernment `quranic:root_000121:B002/m01`; prolonged forward gaze `quranic:root_001594:B001/m01`; projected head and neck `quranic:root_001594:B002/m01`; tear channels at the eye's edges `quranic:root_001077:B004/m01`; sharp wet edges of teeth `quranic:root_001077:B005/m01`; star sinking toward setting `quranic:root_000412:B003/m01`; twilight glow `quranic:root_000803:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The crowd first projects eye, head, and neck forward; at the endpoint, sight sinks. Tear channels and setting light translate the reversal into a horizon inside the face, where the gaze reaches its own west.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Careful fear anticipates an unsecured danger; when the danger arrives, it surrounds, lowers, and visibly masters the body.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; `70:27-28` gives apprehension without security, and `70:44` gives downcast eyes under enveloping humiliation.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Twilight, exposed frontier, pursuing pressure, sinking star, lost hump, low hem, and struck peg all specify the transition from vigilance to abasement.

parent_channels.name: [P2 70:19-44] Guarded Aperture, Legitimate Pair, and Transgressive Crossing

subchannels.name: Beyond the boundary as spreading breach

subchannels.synthesis: “Beyond” is made operational: seek, cross, hide, intermingle, infect, and spread. The wound image is especially exact, because a local breach becomes transgression when its corruption travels past the original boundary.

parent_channels.surprising_reach: Sexual ethics becomes frontier management, paired fitting, contract, hidden breach, spreading wound, and crossed riverbank.

parent_channels.name: [P2 70:19-44] Trust as Recurrent Care and Answerable Custody

subchannels.name: Deposited trust and preserved covenant
subchannels.scene_or_process: Something is deposited with a custodian, specified by prior instruction, and protected under covenant.
subchannels.active_motifs: entrusted security and answerability `quranic:root_000054:B001/m01`; repeated inspection `quranic:root_001055:B001/m01`; prior instruction held for performance `quranic:root_001055:B002/m01`; protected covenant and safe-conduct `quranic:root_001055:B003/m01`; warranty and recourse `quranic:root_001055:B006/m01`; preserving covenant `quranic:root_000574:B006/m01`; treaty and neighborhood bond `quranic:root_000532:B011/m01`.

subchannels.name: Shepherding and corrective return
subchannels.scene_or_process: A keeper feeds and protects a flock, watches its course, listens for need, and turns straying members back.
subchannels.active_motifs: grazing and pasture `quranic:root_000574:B001/m01`; shepherd's protection `quranic:root_000574:B002/m01`; vigilant monitoring `quranic:root_000574:B003/m01`; attentive listening `quranic:root_000574:B004/m01`; return from misconduct `quranic:root_000574:B005/m01`; standing charge over an affair `quranic:root_001273:B004/m01`; gradual nurture and correction `quranic:root_000532:B002/m01`; dependent child under care `quranic:root_000532:B005/m01`; active guarding `quranic:root_000342:B001/m01`.

subchannels.name: Guarantee that permits recourse
subchannels.scene_or_process: A claim is protected by a guarantor, a written warranty, and a right that must be defended if performance fails.
subchannels.active_motifs: commercial warranty `quranic:root_001055:B006/m01`; personal guarantee and written undertaking `quranic:root_001198:B008/m01`; inviolable interest requiring defense `quranic:root_000347:B007/m01`; covenantal bond `quranic:root_000532:B011/m01`; entrusted security `quranic:root_000054:B001/m01`; blood-compensation replacing retaliation `quranic:root_001119:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: A trust becomes institutionally answerable when breach triggers recourse. Warranty, guarantor, defended interest, covenant, and compensation give custody an enforceable underside rather than leaving it to sentiment.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: An entrusted relation survives through repeated inspection, protective management, and liability for what has been received.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; `70:32` joins trusts, covenant, and vigilant care.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Custody becomes shepherding, listening, turning a flock back, written warranty, neighborhood protection, and care of a dependent child.

parent_channels.name: [P2 70:19-44] Witness, Knowledge, and Truth Made Public

subchannels.scene_or_process: A witness is present, sees, rises, and gives a decisive account.

subchannels.synthesis: Testimony requires more than speech. Presence supplies access, sight supplies basis, standing supplies public commitment, and the tongue makes the inwardly known account available to judgment.

subchannels.name: Knowledge retained and marked
subchannels.scene_or_process: Perception becomes knowledge, remains in memory, and is attached to an object by a distinguishing sign.

subchannels.name: Truthful performance versus fabricated interior

parent_channels.name: [P2 70:19-44] Cultivated Enclosure and Honored Residence

subchannels.name: Vegetative enclosure
subchannels.scene_or_process: Trees and vines grow densely enough to form a sheltering interior that also supports grazing life.

parent_channels.name: [P2 70:19-44] Coveted Ingress, Decoy, and Trap

parent_channels.surprising_reach: Garden entry becomes a hunting scene with decoy bird, set snare, raised marker, game, and protective screen.

parent_channels.name: [P2 70:19-44] Radial Crowd and Segmented Entitlement

parent_channels.name: [P2 70:19-44] Horizon Oath and Sovereign Replacement

subchannels.scene_or_process: Light rises and sets across multiple horizon points, making daily recurrence a visible domain of rule.

parent_channels.name: [P2 70:19-44] Wading Play Dissolved into Encounter

parent_channels.name: [P2 70:19-44] Grave Exit, Target-Rush, and Exhausted Finish

parent_channels.name: [P2 70:19-44] Textile Cover, Hidden Interior, and Chromatic Exposure

parent_channels.name: [P2 70:19-44] Joint, Support, and the Upright Load

subchannels.name: Fitted joints around a gap
subchannels.scene_or_process: Separate components meet at seams and joints, leaving controlled openings while forming a load-bearing body.

subchannels.synthesis: Stability is not seamlessness. Socket, seam, strap, rib, and chest permit distinct pieces to move together while controlling their gaps. Guarding an aperture is thus analogous to maintaining a joint: openness is functional only when its boundary remains fitted.

subchannels.name: Upright supports and exact bearing
subchannels.scene_or_process: A structure stands because its path, pillar, tool, and weight remain straight and proportionate.
subchannels.active_motifs: upright rectitude `quranic:root_001273:B008/m01`; sustaining basis of life or structure `quranic:root_001273:B009/m01`; stature `quranic:root_001273:B011/m01`; upright apparatus or leg `quranic:root_001273:B012/m01`; exact balanced weight `quranic:root_001273:B015/m01`; straight unbroken path `quranic:root_000342:B007/m01`; hard straight material `quranic:root_000852:B002/m01`; cohesive material strength `quranic:root_001444:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Uprightness is engineered: a straight route aligns movement, an exact weight balances load, legs and apparatus hold the frame, and cohesive material prevents buckling. Standing testimony is the ethical version of bearing a load without distortion.

subchannels.name: Crossbeam, overload, and stoppage

subchannels.synthesis: A crossbeam converts transverse placement into useful support, but overload turns the same transverse relation into cutting. Fatigue dulls the bearing member until standing becomes immobility rather than strength.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A stable order depends on fitted joints and upright supports that distribute weight without opening a dangerous gap.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; `70:29-34` repeatedly joins guarding to upright maintenance and standing testimony.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Hip socket, interlocked flesh, shoe straps, rib cage, chest, table leg, well apparatus, straight path, exact weight, crossbeam, and exhausted support form one structural field.
