parent_channels.name: S7. [P2 70:19-44] Income, Outgo, Price, and Partner Settlement
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Value enters as revenue, leaves as assessed charge, receives a price, and is divided among partners or heirs.
parent_channels.active_motifs: incoming revenue `quranic:root_000464:B006/m01`; assessed outflow or tax `quranic:root_000400:B003/m01`; valuation and pricing `quranic:root_001273:B010/m01`; partner or heir settlement `quranic:root_000400:B012/m01`; commercial warranty `quranic:root_001055:B006/m01`; alms transfer `quranic:root_000852:B006/m01`; apportioned share `quranic:root_001226:B003/m01`; fixed entitlement `quranic:root_000347:B003/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The scene tracks value through a complete account: revenue enters, charges leave, property is priced, shares are assigned, and partners settle with recourse. It gives the known right in wealth a concrete transactional lifecycle.

parent_channels.name: S8. [Whole-surah 70:1-44] Consecrated Approach to a Sacred Gathering
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A pilgrim enters consecration, assumes a distinctive garment, approaches the sacred House, joins an appointed gathering, faces the prayer direction, and presents an offering for nearness.
parent_channels.active_motifs: sacred House and Mecca `quranic:root_000156:B003/m01`; entering consecration for pilgrimage `quranic:root_000313:B004/m01`; consecrated pilgrim's garment `quranic:root_000313:B010/m01`; gathering place, day, or summons `quranic:root_000259:B004/m01`; designated worship site `quranic:root_000879:B007/m01`; prayer direction `quranic:root_001198:B005/m01`; offering or sacrifice seeking nearness to God `quranic:root_001212:B005/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The rite turns approach into an ordered sequence of restraint, clothing, place, assembly, orientation, and offering. It materializes nearness as disciplined relation rather than mere proximity and usefully pressures the rush toward an erected target in `70:43`: speed toward a visible object is not equivalent to consecrated approach.

parent_channels.name: S9. [Whole-surah 70:1-44] Agate Necklace and Face-Turning Charm
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An agate bead is set among pearls with separators, formed into a necklace, and hung as a charm intended to turn another person's face toward its wearer.
parent_channels.active_motifs: black-and-white agate bead `quranic:root_000243:B005/m01`; spacer bead between pearls `quranic:root_001159:B012/m01`; necklace strung around the neck `quranic:root_001294:B003/m01`; hanging charm made to turn one face toward another `quranic:root_001198:B016/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Material, separator, finished necklace, and intended social effect form one ornament-making scene. It usefully pressures the crowd's radial facing and coveted ingress in `70:35-38`: an assembled charm may solicit a human face, but it cannot turn judgment, confer honor, or secure entry.

parent_channels.name: S10. [Whole-surah 70:1-44] Heated Bath, Bodily Cleansing, and Rest
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A built bath and small heater contain hot water; heat draws sweat, bodily residue is removed by washing, and exertion ends in rest.
parent_channels.active_motifs: bathhouse and small water-heating vessel `quranic:root_000001:B013/m01`; heated water used for bathing `quranic:root_000001:B002/m01`; sweat as heat's bodily trace `quranic:root_000001:B004/m01`; bodily evacuation and cleansing with water or stone `quranic:root_001476:B006/m01`; rest and recovery after fatigue `quranic:root_000609:B007/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The maintenance sequence gives ordinary heat a vessel, room, cleansing function, and endpoint in relief. It reframes the fire's stripping in `70:15-16` by inversion: judgmental heat is not contained for use, its trace cannot be washed away, and its exhaustion does not open into rest.

parent_channels.name: S11. [Whole-surah 70:1-44] Scraped Hide into a Stitched Leather Shelter
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A stiff hair-bearing hide is flayed and scraped, treated with a tanning plant, sewn edge to edge, and made into a leather shelter or spread.
parent_channels.active_motifs: stiff untanned hide `quranic:root_000313:B002/m01`; hide retaining hair during skinning or tanning `quranic:root_000844:B006/m01`; scraping and flaying hide `quranic:root_001476:B003/m01`; green tanning shrub `quranic:root_000076:B005/m01`; stitching hide to hide `quranic:root_000121:B006/m01`; leather tent, screen, or spread `quranic:root_000156:B004/m01`.
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: `70:11,44` يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ، أَبْصَارُهُمْ (`ب ص ر`); `70:11` بَنِيهِ (`ب ن ي`); `70:12` صَاحِبَتِهِ (`ص ح ب`); `70:14` يُنجِيهِ (`ن ج و`); `70:25` الْمَحْرُومِ (`ح ر م`); surface anchor unavailable for `ء ل ي` at `70:4,43`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The craft converts removal into protection: stripping and softening prepare pieces that are joined into cover. It materializes and reverses the surah's exposure sequence, where the fire strips bodily covering and the sheltering kin group cannot shelter; here a hide becomes refuge, while there refuge and hide are both undone.

parent_channels.name: S12. [Whole-surah 70:1-44] Cooked-Food Sale, Known Price, and Revenue
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A food seller and cook prepare meat by pot and fire, cover the vessel, price the food, transfer it at a disclosed price, and receive the resulting income.
parent_channels.active_motifs: seller of prepared foods `quranic:root_000095:B005/m01`; cook or butcher tending a cooking pot `quranic:root_001205:B007/m01`; lid placed over a pot or storage jar `quranic:root_001294:B005/m01`; roasting food by heat `quranic:root_000830:B001/m01`; roast dripping fat `quranic:root_000787:B005/m01`; valuation and pricing `quranic:root_001273:B010/m01`; resale at a known disclosed price `quranic:root_001684:B014/m01`; incoming earnings `quranic:root_000464:B006/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Preparation, containment, valuation, transfer, and revenue form one small commercial cycle. It materializes exchange while usefully pressuring the primary wealth reading: a known price can settle a sale, but the known right in `70:24-25` remains a claim beyond purchase, resale, and earned income.

parent_channels.name: S13. [Whole-surah 70:1-44] Rider's Chant, Horse Nicker, and Accelerated Gait
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A mounted company raises a travel-song and calls aloud; the horse nickers, voices gather into clamor, and the mount passes from a measured gait into a run.
parent_channels.active_motifs: rider's song or camel-driver's raised chant `quranic:root_001507:B009/m01`; vocal call that inclines a hearer `quranic:root_000478:B001/m01`; loud projected voice `quranic:root_000239:B008/m01`; horse's nicker at feed or familiarity `quranic:root_000001:B007/m01`; company clamor and raised voices `quranic:root_001664:B005/m01`; horse's measured running gait `quranic:root_001212:B014/m01`; running or galloping `quranic:root_000993:B002/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Cue, answering sound, coordinated voices, gait, and acceleration make an acoustic locomotion scene. It reframes the surah's summons and final rush: speed can be elicited and coordinated without proving that the travelers possess the right direction, sharply contrasting headlong approach in `70:43` with prayer's self-kept constancy.

parent_channels.name: S14. [Whole-surah 70:1-44] Grinding and Applying Fragrance
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Aromatic material is pounded on a broad stone, used as incense or fragrant camphor, applied as a perfume coating, and left as a perceptible scent.
parent_channels.active_motifs: broad stone for pounding perfume `quranic:root_000879:B008/m01`; aloeswood burned as incense `quranic:root_000076:B014/m01`; fragrant camphor `quranic:root_001307:B011/m01`; perfume paste applied as a coating `quranic:root_000434:B010/m01`; acquired and perceived scent `quranic:root_000609:B004/m01`.
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: `70:2,36` الْكَافِرِينَ، كَفَرُوا (`ك ف ر`); `70:4` الرُّوح (`ر و ح`); `70:19,39` خُلِقَ، خَلَقْنَاهُم (`خ ل ق`); `70:22-23,34` الْمُصَلِّينَ، صَلَاتِهِم (`ص ل و`); surface anchor unavailable for `ء ل ي` at `70:4,43`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Tool, aromatic matter, application, and sensory residue form a complete preparation practice. It usefully pressures the created-disposition reading in `70:19-35`: an applied coating can change how a body smells, but it cannot change the inward form whose recurrent conduct the surah diagnoses.

parent_channels.name: S15. [Whole-surah 70:1-44] Prayer for Spectators and the Turn to Backbiting
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A worshipper performs in the prescribed direction to be seen, witnesses carry the act into public reputation, and observers turn from praise to disparaging speech.
parent_channels.active_motifs: prescribed worship `quranic:root_000879:B003/m01`; prayer direction `quranic:root_001198:B005/m01`; action performed for people to see `quranic:root_000531:B005/m01`; witnessing through present observation `quranic:root_000822:B001/m01`; good repute carried abroad `quranic:root_000745:B008/m01`; attacking a person through backbiting `quranic:root_001675:B013/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Correct posture and direction can be recruited into a spectator economy of display, reputation, and hostile talk. This usefully pressures the primary portrait of enduring prayer and standing witness: public visibility can be manipulated, whereas the guarded practices in `70:22-35` are defined by recurrence and answerability rather than audience response.

parent_channels.name: S16. [P1 70:1-18 to P2 70:19-44] Opposed Winds around a Fixed Center
parent_channels.scene_or_process: The dabbur wind comes from behind the Kaaba, the opposing saba wind faces it from the front, and oblique winds vary between those bearings.
parent_channels.active_motifs: dabbur wind coming from behind the Kaaba or the west `quranic:root_000458:B012/m01`; saba wind opposing the dabbur and facing the prayer direction `quranic:root_001198:B012/m01`; crosswinds with differing bearings `quranic:root_001489:B014/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Front, back, and oblique only become coherent through a shared center. The compass scene materializes the reversal from turning one's back in P1 to facing in P2 and clarifies the right-left and east-west field of `70:37-40`: moral orientation is a bearing within a governed frame, not a position defined by the crowd itself.

parent_channels.name: S17. [P1 70:1-18 to P2 70:19-44] Palm Heart, Overlapping Crop, and Date Basket
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Fronds near the palm's heart support a fruit-cluster base; a new spadix emerges while an older crop remains, palm leaf is woven into a date basket, and fresh dates eventually dry past ripeness.
parent_channels.active_motifs: fronds beside the palm's heart `quranic:root_001056:B004/m01`; base of the palm fruit cluster `quranic:root_001056:B010/m01`; new palm spadix appearing while an old crop remains `quranic:root_001358:B006/m01`; woven palm-leaf basket for fresh dates `quranic:root_000464:B010/m01`; fresh dates beginning to dry past ripeness `quranic:root_001684:B016/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The palm produces both successive food and the material used to contain it, but the contained crop continues toward decay. This causal cycle usefully pressures the surah's gathering and garden readings: collection can preserve a harvest temporarily, yet neither storage nor possession makes provision permanent.

parent_channels.name: S18. [P1 70:1-18 to P2 70:19-44] Stranger, Confidant, and Royal Favorite
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A stranger is admitted into personal confidence and then occupies the privileged circle of a ruler as companion, counselor, or minister.
parent_channels.active_motifs: outsider called a son of the earth `quranic:root_000025:B004/m01`; selected confidant and intimate companion `quranic:root_000059:B006/m01`; favored intimates, companions, and ministers of a king `quranic:root_001212:B004/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The progression distinguishes spatial approach from granted intimacy and rank. It usefully pressures the expectation of honored ingress in `70:35-38`: standing near a sovereign or joining a surrounding crowd does not itself convert an outsider into a confidant or favorite; access is relationally conferred.

parent_channels.name: S19. [P1 70:1-18 to P2 70:19-44] Advance Scouts, Divided Host, and Battle Line
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Scouts move ahead of an arriving host, the army forms its divisions, opponents stand against one another, and open war is declared.
parent_channels.active_motifs: advance scouts preceding an army `quranic:root_000138:B008/m01`; large army or host divided into five parts `quranic:root_000439:B007/m01`; enemy and state of enmity `quranic:root_000993:B003/m01`; standing against an opponent in combat `quranic:root_001273:B014/m01`; confronting another with war `quranic:root_001507:B008/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Reconnaissance, division, opposition, and confrontation make a host structurally different from an undirected crowd. The sequence reframes the surah's large number, radial factions, and final rush: quantity and speed do not amount to disciplined alignment, and standing in ranks does not transfer command to those who assemble.

parent_channels.name: S20. [P1 70:1-18 to P2 70:19-44] Death, Orphan, and Successor-Guardian
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A deceased person is laid on the right side; an orphan remains within a network of kinship, clientage, or neighborhood, and a successor assumes care.
parent_channels.active_motifs: kinship, clientage, emancipation, and neighborhood affiliation `quranic:root_001684:B005/m01`; guardian standing over an orphan `quranic:root_001664:B007/m01`; death marked by laying the body on its right side `quranic:root_001698:B007/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: Death does not erase relation; it changes the living relative's role into answerable care for a dependent. This progression reverses the attempted use of children and kin as disposable ransom in P1 and supports P2's trust-and-right structure: vulnerability generates custody rather than exchangeability.
